quest.title: Wherefore Did the Spiritstone Descend?
quest.description: Having taken out the Abyss Lectors lurking here, you discover that Zhiqiong has seen the symbols on the key-like object the Lectors left behind somewhere else...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: It's great to see that you're alright! What... what were those two creatures? I've never seen anyone... or anything like that... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, there's no need to be so strict. I won't risk provoking them, I know...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you get in front of us?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: We came through a hidden mine on the western side that just so happens to let us get around the areas infested with the black matter and the strange creatures below... *cough* Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I'm fine, I'm fine... That road was pretty hard to find. It might've been some sort of path the Treasure Hoarders carved out en route to their loot stashes... But I can't imagine them wanting to come this far down, either...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Well, our campsite isn't too far away. Let's talk as we go, shall we?

talks.objective: Go to the camp with Zhiqiong

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* Oh, hello there. Is there something you need?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're coughing away! You sure you're okay?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I'm alright, really... The air down here is just kinda thin, which doesn't sit too well with me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. This is the map that I drew earlier... *cough* *cough* Ugh. Well, that feels better.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you'd best rest up. Don't go running around all over the place, now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of maps, we've got one for you as well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a map of "The Two Strange Bells"... Seems like it's something those dastardly Fatui left behind!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Thank you! I'll incorporate this new location into my map!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: ...Wait a moment. Did you say "Fatui"? They've tunneled into this place as well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly looks like it.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got to be even more careful while exploring The Chasm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we found this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've been around here more, Zhiqiong, so you probably know what this is used for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: This? I think I found a gate with a symbol similar to this one somewhere deeper down.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* Ah, sorry. If I remember correctly, you could hear the wind behind that gate... I'm quite sure that there should be a large open space behind it for us to explore.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I wonder what relationship this thing has to that gate? Might it be a key of some sort? *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Zhiqiong's right. This is a device used to unlock the gate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A "hello" before joining the conversation might be nice.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Sorry, um... I was just too eager to say that this strange device is indeed used to open doors.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I once looked into similar devices, and just as luck might have it, the device in your hands is an exact match to the one in my research lab.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, neither alchemy nor basic mechanics can help us understand the energy held within these devices, nor can they explain the principles behind their ability to unlock and lock gates...

choices.text: A research lab...?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: We Amurta take a rather dim view of those who rely purely on theory. That said, we often have to work with those blockheads from Spantamad all the same...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: *sigh* Well, that's all I can tell you. There isn't much else to be said with regard to the Akademiya...

choices.text: Oh, I have a pillow right here, you can keep talking...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Oh, I'll stop, I'll stop... I didn't form this exploration team to divulge all our secrets or something.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Whatever the case, if we're able to find that gate that Zhiqiong spoke of, we'll be able to use this strange device to open it.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Let's go together then, shall we? Ever since you shared this new map with me, I've been left with this last section unmapped!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I just thought that we could... *cough* ... Whoops, sorry. You know, we could get it all done in one go! *cough* Haha... *cough* Sorry, sorry... *cough*

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: We can leave the map thing aside for now. Have you... had close contact with that black, muddy stuff at any point?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Oh, I'm fine. The environment's just not sitting too well with me, y'know? I mean, this is nothing for a true adventurer! *cough* *cough*

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Nothing? Hey. You'd better wake up, you hear? You're the only person — I repeat, the only person in the whole team — who has shown such serious negative reactions during this process.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: We have to send you up to the surface to rest. If we go now, there's still time.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Alright, alright, don't look at me like that. Do whatever you want. It's not as if I'm your parent or something.

choices.text: Will you really be fine?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, you've been coughing this whole way!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* I'm fine... I can take it.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I joined this team of my own accord. I'm not going to change my decision based on what others say.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Mm, yes. And I suppose that as an adventurer, your primary concern is the remuneration?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: If you're willing to leave, I'll make sure you're compensated. It'll be quite the generous package. The representatives from Liyue will understand as well.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: #*cough* *cough* Sorry, I'll have to excuse myself now. The area {NICKNAME} cleared out needs re-mapping. I shan't waste your time any further.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: #Right, {NICKNAME}. I'll head to the gate that I mentioned before later. If that's where you're headed as well, we can meet up there.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Hmph, this kid... is not to be reasoned with. At all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're being too harsh on Zhiqiong, Khedive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly. You were so curt, and you didn't explain anything either. Is there any wonder that you ticked her off?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Heh. I just didn't expect that she would have literally no concern for her life at all! ...You know what? Forget it. She can do what she wants.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: And then she'll regret it later... and ask for help. That's how young people are. Always got to take a hit or two before they learn.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What exactly is wrong with Zhiqiong, anyway?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: What we're facing is, in essence, very similar to the anomalies on Dragonspine, in the sense that their source is something alien to this world we know... and it involves the clash of two energies.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: #And that is why we had to get you on the team, {NICKNAME}, since you are able to manipulate the elements without the use of a Vision.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: For normal people like us who neither have Visions nor can manipulate the elements, these anomalies are malignant, even fatal.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Those who have close contact with the source of the anomalies may begin to lose touch with the world. Some will weaken swiftly and even...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Zhiqiong...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Is in trouble.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: That's as much as I can say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, then what are we supposed to do? Should we chase after her?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: *sigh* It's her choice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But we can't just stand by and watch... We should at least try, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Well, don't let me delay you either way. I'll leave you to your own business... There are still a great many secrets for us to discover down there.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: And... if you meet Zhiqiong, please take care of her on behalf of the rest of us.

choices.text: Khedive, do you mind explaining?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'm telling you this out of the goodness of my heart. Don't take it for a reason to violate the strictures of the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: ...I'm sorry, I cannot divulge the details, but Zhiqiong has to get some distance from the thing under The Chasm... No, she has to leave The Chasm itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what... C'mon, you're talking in riddles! Are you just annoyed that Zhiqiong's not well or something?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: She is very sick, yes, and if no one takes it more seriously, it really will be too late.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Alright, please, just stop it... *cough*

choices.text: You can keep going. Not that we'll understand or anything, of course.
Aren't you a paleontologist?

talks.objective: Go to the gate that Zhiqiong mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (This stone tablet looks a fair bit more recent than the rest of the ruins. It seems to have been set up not long ago.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (Although the inscription cannot be understood per se, a little observation reveals that the engraving is a map of the surrounding area.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (The tablet is also engraved with some complex pictures that have something to do with the giant crystal suspended before you...)

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: #*cough* *cough* Hey, {NICKNAME}, you're here! *cough*

choices.text: What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* What's wrong? You don't look so good. Did I annoy you in some way?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y'know, Paimon's having trouble telling who looks worse between the two of you...

choices.text: The road ahead is very dangerous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, everyone's actually... really concerned about you. Please don't care so little about your own safety...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I... Of course I know they're worried. But it's like I said before. This is what an adventurer's life should be like!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: No adventurers in this world would balk in the face of danger! And I have no wish to lie in bed in my dotage, withered by age, relying on others to eat or even to get myself to the toilet!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: If the alternative is stability and boredom, I'll choose danger any day. I'd rather lay my life down here than lie in some cushy bed waiting for time to claim me.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I belong here. I know it. A comfy job with the Ministry? That's not for me. Khedive's Mora? It doesn't own me.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And as opposed to those lucky few who have Visions...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Adventure, exploration, challenge — these are things that can only be truly experienced by normal people like us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So when it comes down to it, it's all about you, huh? Haven't you spared a single thought for others?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I've said it before, this is my own personal business. It's got nothing to do with anyone else. I'm... sorry that they might feel bad about the matter, but...

choices.text: Must you really go deep into such dangerous places?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Yes. I mean, no... I mean, yes! I just... I don't want to be forgotten.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: At least this way I'll leave some maps behind, and I'll have borne witness to the sights of The Chasm... and I would have accomplished all this, stepping into the realm of the forbidden, as a normal human being!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And the trail of the Yaksha who defended Liyue in legends might be behind this gate. If I could reach that place...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I don't know if I can make it there, but... I wish that I could get closer to these unknown places. Perhaps we might truly find the reason for the anomalies here in The Chasm...

choices.text: Everyone needs a rest, ordinary or not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're all worried about you. Please don't take such poor care of yourself...

choices.text: What you need to do right now is regain your strength.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, that's right, you should totally get some more rest! The road ahead is still plenty dangerous. You can just wait for us to finish clearing the obstacles ahead before following after. It won't be too late!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway... um... Someone needs to record down what we've seen, right? If no one records the stuff, no one will remember it, after all!

choices.text: Huh, you've got a point there, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hee-hee!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I get it... I'll go back if you insist. But please, you keep your wits about you as well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We will! Stay safe on the way back, now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Paimon has no idea if she really heard a word we said.

choices.text: Paimon being reasonable? Say it isn't so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, what are you talking about?

choices.text: Please, go back to the camp and take a rest.
There may be worse things behind that gate.
You want to leave a memory of yourself behind, do you?
You need to get more rest.
Found you.

talks.objective: Go within the gate to investigate
Go within the gate to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Great, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: There've been several earthquakes ever since you went through that gate. We don't know what's going on down there, but we're glad to see that you're both okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you don't look too bad yourself. Looks like the rest helped, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things on your end?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I've followed your advice and rested here all this while. I'm feeling a whole lot better now... Was this all due to "that thing" behind the gate?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I didn't go in there, but I could feel some strange pulsing within... Something amazing must have been back there, I'm sure of it...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

choices.text: Well, we didn't meet this Yaksha you speak of...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I see... Thank you. So, as for the dark mud we... *cough* Sorry...

choices.text: It hasn't been completely cleared out yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, now that we've removed the taint from that large crystal, that stinky mud should be back underground in no time!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I understand... *cough* I'll inform the other team members. It seems that our exploration of The Chasm... has met with some initial success.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is way stronger than that time at Qiaoying Village...

choices.text: Any future plans?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, we could use this opportunity to become an official exploratory team under the Ministry of Civil Affairs... But I don't think we'll be going anywhere any time soon.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: After all, it was due to your spelunking that we were able to avoid the perils of the path, such that no one was injured or lost, and that our material losses proved negligible.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I think that we might stay here for a while yet, help the Ministry staff watch over the underground anomalies, and maintain the exploration facilities.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you encounter any strangers after we left?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What? Hmm... Well, I didn't see anyone on the way back and I fell asleep pretty quickly once I got back to camp, so I didn't see anyone else pass by.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What's wrong? What's with the sudden question?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, never mind, it's nothing...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Well, if you're leaving, don't forget to say hi to Muning as well... *cough* Tell him... that I'm gonna be promoted. Who knows who's gonna be the boss of who before long, eh?

choices.text: Are you all leaving?
"Qiaoying Village"? What's that?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmm? It's the most famous teahouse in Liyue. Top notch scenery, top-notch tea... You haven't heard of it?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, not that I like the place very much... Even if it is my second home after Mingyun Village. I know every last creek and tree in that place like the back of my hand.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I guess I would've remembered the place and the people more fondly if it wasn't for that disagreement I had with that one commission-giver while on a map-making assignment... Eh, whatever. No point talking about that now.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And well, I say I don't like the place, but if I do achieve something great this time, it would be good to go back there to rest... The old man's tea is a truly unforgettable experience, after all.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But over to more pleasant thoughts... The next time I'm back home, I'll be a famous adventurer having tea with the old man, you know? I do hope you'll be there to see it.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Heh, there I go again, talking about unrealistic stuff.

choices.text: It'll experience a gradual retreat.
There was a huge floating crystal in there...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So the crystal in the upper levels did fly towards it — a fragment desiring to be part of the whole once again.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So that's the key to solving the mystery of The Chasm... I might go and see it for myself later.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Thank you. So, as for that dark mud... *cough* Sorry...

choices.text: It hasn't been completely cleared out yet.
It'll experience a gradual retreat.

talks.objective: Go within the gate to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This doesn't look like a natural cave. It looks like something huge cut right through this place instead... Huh. Actually, "rammed right through" might be more accurate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Y'know, {NICKNAME}... Don't you think this floating thingy looks rather familiar? This resembles what we saw on top of Dragonspine back then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Their... "smell"... or "aura"...? Is pretty similar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatever it is, it's really spooky...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you discovered, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, whatever it is, this is pretty creepy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, doesn't that stone tablet look kinda new to you? It doesn't look like it fits in with the ruins around it at all!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Stone Stele
dialogues.text: (Although the inscription cannot be understood per se, a little observation reveals that the engraving is a map of the surrounding area, and that the other pictures have something to do with the floating crystal...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, so the big crystal has five weird devices around it, and these lines are connected to the crystal... Gah, Paimon can't read this! Why is this diagram so messy!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we need to activate those five devices...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, uh, someone needs to hit the crystal or something... and then the black spots will disappear...

choices.text: So the application of external force can speed up the purification...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After that... Wait a minute, why did they draw this big worm? Hmm... Seems like this stone tablet is telling us to beware of the super big worm.

choices.text: Perhaps it's warning us to beware of stepping on worms...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... That sounds a lot easier to get... But still, we've got to try before we know for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Also, {NICKNAME}, look at that purple-blackish stuff. It's all over that big crystal! Looks pretty similar to that dark mud we encountered before, too.

choices.text: This looks exactly as depicted on the stone tablet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm, yeah, you're right...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh ho? Very fearless of you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we're already here, so we might as well do something.

choices.text: Well, let's start from activating those devices.
So hitting the crystal will awaken some kind of giant creature?
I guess they just forgot to draw those splotches.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... Looks like we've come to the bit where we've got to "apply some external force to the crystal." You ready, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Are you sure the diagrams on the stone tablet are reliable?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we've come this far. Let's just give it a shot like we always do, eh?

choices.text: But...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, come on, it's a big crystal! Don't you just wanna poke it?

choices.text: Ah, Paimon, what will I ever do with you...
Do we really have to...?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the unexpected collapse occurs, you manage to escape to safety in time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Is... Is it over? It all kinda feels like a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like that thing up there has gone back to normal. The air feels less heavy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, even though we've reached the bottom of The Chasm and even defeated the creature down there somehow... But it doesn't feel like we've answered any questions!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In fact, we've got more questions now than we did before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like for example... What was that thing above us? Why did a giant serpent come roaring out? Where did that dark mud and the strange monsters come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The monsters that followed the dark mud here seemed to be eating at the big crystal, and Zhiqiong mentioned that a Yaksha was here once...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh, this is way too many questions for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like The Chasm still has many secrets that are yet to be discovered...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, no wonder adventurers like Zhiqiong are so committed to exploring this place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But things should quiet down a bit in here now that we've cleared this big thing up, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Still looks like a long way off before the mines can reopen...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But our exploration mission seems complete. We'll worry about that other stuff in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, one more thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like... someone helped us out during that fight with the big snake. Did you hear this "shoom" sound during the fight?

choices.text: No...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Well, never mind. When we head back, we can ask Zhiqiong if she saw any strangers!

choices.text: ...Sort of.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Great, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: There've been several earthquakes ever since you went through that gate. We don't know what's going on down there, but we're glad to see that you're both okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you don't look too bad yourself. Looks like the rest helped, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are things on your end?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I've followed your advice and rested here all this while. I'm feeling a whole lot better now... Was this all due to "that thing" behind the gate?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I didn't go in there, but I could feel some strange pulsing within... Something amazing must have been back there, I'm sure of it...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* I grew up listening to tales of the Yakshas, and some of my seniors used to say that one of them was sealed inside The Chasm and slumbers to this day.

choices.text: Well, we didn't meet this Yaksha you speak of...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I see... Thank you. So, as for the dark mud we... *cough* Sorry...

choices.text: It hasn't been completely cleared out yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, now that we've removed the taint from that large crystal, that stinky mud should be back underground in no time!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I understand... *cough* I'll inform the other team members. It seems that our exploration of The Chasm... has met with some initial success.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: This is way stronger than that time at Qiaoying Village...

choices.text: Any future plans?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, we could use this opportunity to become an official exploratory team under the Ministry of Civil Affairs... But I don't think we'll be going anywhere any time soon.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: After all, it was due to your spelunking that we were able to avoid the perils of the path, such that no one was injured or lost, and that our material losses proved negligible.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I think that we might stay here for a while yet, help the Ministry staff watch over the underground anomalies, and maintain the exploration facilities.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you encounter any strangers after we left?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What? Hmm... Well, I didn't see anyone on the way back and I fell asleep pretty quickly once I got back to camp, so I didn't see anyone else pass by.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What's wrong? What's with the sudden question?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, never mind, it's nothing...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Well, if you're leaving, don't forget to say hi to Muning as well... *cough* Tell him... that I'm gonna be promoted. Who knows who's gonna be the boss of who before long, eh?

choices.text: Are you all leaving?
"Qiaoying Village"? What's that?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmm? It's the most famous teahouse in Liyue. Top notch scenery, top-notch tea... You haven't heard of it?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, not that I like the place very much... Even if it is my second home after Mingyun Village. I know every last creek and tree in that place like the back of my hand.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I guess I would've remembered the place and the people more fondly if it wasn't for that disagreement I had with that one commission-giver while on a map-making assignment... Eh, whatever. No point talking about that now.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And well, I say I don't like the place, but if I do achieve something great this time, it would be good to go back there to rest... The old man's tea is a truly unforgettable experience, after all.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But over to more pleasant thoughts... The next time I'm back home, I'll be a famous adventurer having tea with the old man, you know? I do hope you'll be there to see it.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Heh, there I go again, talking about unrealistic stuff.

choices.text: It'll experience a gradual retreat.
There was a huge floating crystal in there...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So that's the key to solving the mystery of The Chasm... I might go and see it for myself later.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: *cough* Thank you. So, as for that dark mud... *cough* Sorry...

choices.text: It hasn't been completely cleared out yet.
It'll experience a gradual retreat.

talks.objective: Defeat the monster lurking in The Chasm's depths
Return to camp and talk to Zhiqiong

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: #You're back, {NICKNAME}! How did things go? There's good news to be had from underground, I hope?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Muning everything...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Hahaha! See what I told you? The exploration team were a reliable lot, and the expedition was bound to be fruitful!

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: I have received the ore samples and data that Khedive and Jinwu have gathered. The unknown matter is in full retreat, and the geological shifts have largely ceased...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: ...It's a good omen indeed. Thanks to your help, the Millelith have also expressed no objections to our plans for further exploration and restoration. In fact, they should be getting ready to descend into the mine themselves...

choices.text: Sorry, did you say something before?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, that's right... So, who was the one who was trying their best to prevent us from going down previously, huh?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Uh, hehe... Come on now, there's no need to be so straight about such things.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: I mean, I will pay you. And of course, The Chasm Exploration Team will become an official part of Huishan Hall from this day forth!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You need to work on your ability to change the topic...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! But since there's Mora to be had, we'll forgive you this time.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Haha, thank you... And you know, I did get a real earful from the higher-ups myself for letting you go down there without so much as a report back to headquarters...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The higher-ups... Who?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and who would bother coming down here themselves to give you an earful anyway?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You might not believe me... But it was the Yuheng herself. She seemed quite concerned for your safety.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, seriously? So Keqing's been keeping an eye on us this whole time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, but the person we met down there didn't look anything like her!

choices.text: You actually saw that person clearly?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You forgot? It's the one that went "shoom" and went right by us! It was super flashy and stuff!

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: You met someone else down there? Are you certain that it wasn't a Treasure Hoarder or a Fatuus?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Hmm... This is certainly worth recording. But don't worry, the Millelith will help you look into it.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #Ah yes, {NICKNAME}... Since I'm currently in charge of the exploration team's material needs, could I also ask you how things are with them at the moment?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Zhiqiong isn't looking too good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right... she's still down in the mines, and she's not in the best of conditions.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Hmm... Jinwu did mention her condition to me. I'll send a report recommending that the Ministry send a medical team down. With any luck, she'll be patient and stay out of any hazardous zones.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Clitopho joined up, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He was a Treasure Hoarder previously. Will things really be okay?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Oh, him? We all know him. He's not a bad person by nature.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: #If you were able to trust him, {NICKNAME}, I don't think we'd gainsay you. Still, I think he'll have to wait for a while before he can be welcomed in any official capacity. Let's just call it a probation period, shall we?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About Khedive...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Oh, that fellow from Sumeru? Well, I won't lie to you — you can think of him as a sort of "proxy."

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: On the surface, he seems to be the organizer and the overall in-charge, but in truth, even he answers to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Of course, this comes with some "academic agreement" that the Qixing have with the Akademiya... The people upstairs went back and forth with the Akademiya for a while over this... and I'm not at liberty to say more, in any case.

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Whatever the case, a researcher from overseas is not exactly someone we would normally use...

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: But since he's willing to pay for the team from his own pocket, I suppose we have little reason to refuse his help.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, what's the arrangement going to be from now on?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: The Ministry will send more people down there. I suppose we've got to trouble our dedicated professional to delve into the perilous depths for us again...

choices.text: "Your" dedicated professional?

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: *cough* Aaaanyway, thanks for your help! You're always welcome here at The Chasm, yes, indeed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there you go again, changing the topic so suddenly!

response.speaker: Muning
response.text: Okay, okay, let's not get too hot and bothered about that. In any case, the Ministry thanks you for your services, and we will not stand in the way of your activities within The Chasm any further.

choices.text: "Again"...?
What person?
I don't remember you expressing such effusive support before.
